plugin.name: Seedream & Seedance
plugin.description: Create images and videos with your Ark or BytePlus account.
plugin.longDescription: Seedream images and Seedance 2.5/2.0 videos, with independent Ark and BytePlus keys. Ark images and videos share one key. Supports image references and first/last frames. Video tasks can resume after restart. Stop ends local waiting; remote work may continue and incur charges. Existing built-in settings are not migrated by this plugin.
config.ark.title: Volcengine Ark API key
config.ark.description: Used for Seedream images and Seedance videos in China.
config.byteplus.title: BytePlus ModelArk API key
config.byteplus.description: Used only for Dreamina Seedance videos in your BytePlus account.
